difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms X -> Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, if X -> Z is locally quasi-finite then so is X -> Y (source lines 5524-5530). The proof chooses a three-column diagram of schemes U -> V -> W with surjective etale vertical arrows, so that the local quasi-finiteness of the composite becomes a statement about the top row of schemes, and then applies the scheme case of permanence of local quasi-finiteness to U -> V -> W.
